title: Aider's Polyglot Coding Benchmark
best_for_zh: 关注多语言代码编辑、仓库级补丁生成和测试驱动代码评测的读者。
one_line: Aider Polyglot evaluates coding-edit ability across C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust using selected Exercism problems and repository-level test feedback.
Aider Polyglot 使用筛选后的 Exercism 题目，评测模型在 C++、Go、Java、JavaScript、Python 和 Rust 中完成代码编辑并通过测试的能力。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Primary source: https://aider.chat/2024/12/21/polyglot.html. Venue/status: Aider official benchmark release, 2024. The problem is to evaluate Patch or repository edit plus test outcome. under a benchmark surface whose feedback is unit tests and correct edit-format checks. The decision boundary is evaluation and audit: it is not a training recipe, not a general proof of model reliability, and not a reusable reward unless the official source separately releases that contract.

The data object is composed of language, exercise, file context, model edit, test result, correct-edit-format result. The benchmark matters because it measures a concrete surface that ordinary static QA or single-function coding tests do not fully cover. For screening, read the card with the source version, scorer, split policy, and released artifacts attached to any claimed score.

一手来源：https://aider.chat/2024/12/21/polyglot.html，代码仓库为 https://github.com/Aider-AI/polyglot-benchmark。官方发布日期是 2024-12-21；目录名保留 2025 只是本地标识。它要解决的问题，是评测模型能否在多种编程语言中通过代码编辑完成真实练习。

数据对象包括语言、练习题、文件上下文、模型编辑、测试结果和编辑格式结果。反馈来自题目测试和 Aider 的编辑格式检查。边界要收窄到评测和审计：它不是训练配方，也不能代表所有软件工程任务。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
One-sentence contribution: Aider Polyglot evaluates coding-edit ability across C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust using selected Exercism problems and repository-level test feedback. The core mechanism is to turn a realistic task substrate into an observable input-output-scoring contract rather than only reporting model impressions.

Inputs come from Exercism coding exercises and Aider editing setup.; outputs are Patch or repository edit plus test outcome.; feedback is Problem tests and edit-format checks. It belongs under benchmark/evaluation surfaces because the central artifact is the measurement contract. Closest comparisons are other benchmark surfaces in the same domain, but this card should be read at the level of the released task object and scorer rather than as a broad model capability claim.

一句话贡献：Aider Polyglot 用六种语言的 Exercism 题目评测模型的多语言代码编辑能力。核心机制是从 697 道题中筛出较难的 225 道，让模型通过 Aider 生成补丁并接受测试。

输入是练习题和文件上下文；输出是代码补丁或仓库编辑；反馈是测试是否通过以及编辑格式是否正确。它应归在评测面方向，因为主要贡献是任务选择、语言覆盖和测试反馈契约。

title: Method
方法
html:
The evaluation pipeline is: present the task input, run the model or agent in the specified substrate, collect the submitted artifact, execute or apply the scorer, and aggregate the result under the official leaderboard/reporting policy. The substrate is Aider coding harness over C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust tasks.

The verifier/reward component is Problem tests and edit-format checks. Outputs are interpreted only through that contract; training or optimization use is not assumed. Reproducibility depends on pinning the task version, harness or judge version, model settings, release license, and hidden/public split policy. Artifacts to verify are paper=https://aider.chat/2024/12/21/polyglot.html, project=https://aider.chat/2024/12/21/polyglot.html, code=https://github.com/Aider-AI/polyglot-benchmark, data=https://github.com/Aider-AI/polyglot-benchmark.

评测流程是：收集 C++、Go、Java、JavaScript、Python 和 Rust 的 Exercism 练习，先用多个模型筛题，再保留被三个或更少筛选模型解决的 225 道题，最后让被测模型通过 Aider 生成编辑并运行测试。

评分组件是题目测试和正确编辑格式检查。输出只能说明模型在这个题集、仓库版本和 Aider 设置下的表现。复现时需要固定 polyglot-benchmark 仓库提交、Aider 版本、模型设置、语言工具链和测试环境。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is the official source at https://aider.chat/2024/12/21/polyglot.html. It identifies the benchmark surface, task form, and feedback contract used for reporting. Where code or data are public, the relevant artifact URLs are code=https://github.com/Aider-AI/polyglot-benchmark and data=https://github.com/Aider-AI/polyglot-benchmark.

The evidence boundary is intentionally narrow. Public pages can establish task intent and scoring language, but they may not expose every prompt, hidden test, judge prompt, or leaderboard filter. Any numerical comparison should therefore cite the exact page snapshot, benchmark version, and evaluator settings.

最强证据来自官方来源 https://aider.chat/2024/12/21/polyglot.html。该来源能确认评测面的任务形态、对象和反馈契约。若代码或数据公开，对应工件是 code=https://github.com/Aider-AI/polyglot-benchmark，data=https://github.com/Aider-AI/polyglot-benchmark。

证据边界要写清楚：公开页面可以确认评测意图和评分语言，但未必公开全部 prompt、隐藏测试、评审提示词或排行榜过滤规则。任何数值比较都应注明页面快照、benchmark 版本和评估设置。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior baselines are generic benchmark leaderboards, single-answer task sets, or narrower domain tests. What changes here is the measurement surface: it asks whether a model can complete Patch or repository edit plus test outcome. under unit tests and correct edit-format checks.

The direction signal is useful because it moves evaluation toward the artifact or workflow that users actually inspect. The quality signal is strongest when the scorer, split, and artifact version are explicit. What is not new is the general idea of benchmarking models; the reusable contribution is the particular task object plus feedback contract. Reuse checks should ask: separate benchmark release date from card id; official blog is dated 2024-12-21; pin repository revision for reproducible comparisons.

已有基线多只看单语言代码题或完整代码生成。这里的新意在于同时考察六种语言，并把评测对象放在补丁式代码编辑场景里。

方向信号来自跨语言稳定性：模型可能在一种语言强，在另一种语言弱。质量信号取决于筛题方法、题目仓库版本、测试覆盖和工具链固定。并不新的部分是用单元测试评分代码；可复用的部分是多语言题集选择和 Aider 编辑反馈契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Limitations center on scorer coverage, release boundary, and snapshot drift. A hidden test, human vote, or judge rubric can be appropriate for the benchmark while still missing important semantic failures. Public visibility can also create contamination risk.

Scores should not be read outside the official harness. Different model scaffolds, sampling settings, browser or tool versions, prompt filters, and hidden-set policies can change outcomes. Official Aider blog and GitHub repository verify language mix, 225-task selection, and benchmark purpose.

主要限制来自 Exercism 题目的覆盖范围、测试充分性和工具链版本。通过测试不等于代码风格、性能和边界行为都最优。

分数不能脱离 Aider 设置解释。不同模型上下文窗口、编辑格式、依赖版本和语言工具链都会影响结果。官方博客和 GitHub 仓库能确认语言组合、225 题选择和评测目的；比较分数时要固定仓库快照。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this card to decide whether Aider's Polyglot Coding Benchmark is the right evaluation surface for a model, agent, or system claim. It is especially useful when the claim concerns the same artifact type and feedback contract described above.

For collection and comparison, record the official source URL, benchmark version, model setup, and scorer. Avoid using the benchmark name alone as evidence; the useful unit is the pinned task/scorer/snapshot tuple.

这张卡适合用来判断 Aider's Polyglot Coding Benchmark 是否匹配某个模型、智能体或系统声明。只有当声明涉及同类任务工件和同类反馈契约时，它才是强证据。

用于比较时，应记录官方来源、benchmark 版本、模型设置和评分器。不要只引用 benchmark 名称；真正有意义的单位是固定后的任务、评分器和快照。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the official source first, then inspect public artifacts if available. Confirm title/version, release date, task count, scorer, split policy, license, and whether model scores are from a live leaderboard or a static report.

Watch for overclaims: benchmark success is not the same as trustworthy deployment, full correctness, or training signal quality. If an artifact is private, record that boundary explicitly rather than filling it with inference.

阅读顺序是先看官方页面，再看公开代码或数据。需要确认标题和版本、发布日期、任务数量、评分器、划分策略、许可协议，以及分数来自动态排行榜还是静态报告。

警惕过度解释：benchmark 成功不等于可部署可信、完全正确或适合作为训练信号。如果某些工件不公开，应把这个边界写明，而不是用推测补齐。
